messages:
kira: Starting staged rollout v2.14.0 -> 10% in eu-west during quiet window (20:00-21:00). Release notes: https://redwood.dev/releases/2.14.0 — includes kvcache fix and batching opt.
deploybot: [automated] initiating traffic shift: service=inference region=eu-west from=stable to=v2.14.0 percent=10
sam: noted. monitoring dashboards up. will watch auth & edge 5xx.
mike: quick heads-up — saw a small auth spike on edge-a after warmup (~+2%). could be retries.
olivia: Oncall here. if >3% 5xx sustained for 5m we should pause.
deploybot: [automated] traffic shift progress: 3/10 nodes shifted. ETA ~2m.
kira: pinging infra for cookie routing changes @oncall-bot
oncall-bot: pinging infra-oncall-team: confirm no config drifts in edge routing for eu-west.
sam: logs show repeated 502s from upstream pool-eu-a trace abc123..abc127. sample logs:
```
2026-03-21T20:05:12Z edge-a connection error -> 502 upstream reset trace=abc123
2026-03-21T20:05:18Z edge-b 200 ok trace=abc124
```
mike: pattern suggests backend transient. if it spikes to 4% stop rollout.
kira: manual hold. pausing now.
deploybot: [automated] rollout paused by kira — current percent=10. reason="manual pause requested". To resume: `/deploy resume 1771234560`.
sam: forwarded traces to backend owners; they're investigating pool-eu-a. will update in 2m.
mike: recommend pinning affected nodes to v2.13.9.
kira: pause + inspect :thumbsup:
olivia: formal stopvote :thumbsup: — halting ramp until backend confirms.
oncall-bot: escalation: paging infra-oncall — incident IR-2026-031
sam: backend rolled quick patch to connection pool config; rerunning healthchecks.
sam: healthchecks show error rate down to ~0.3% over 3m.
mike: recommend revert affected hosts to v2.13.9 as safety net.
kira: agree. minimal revert on affected hosts.
sam: running revert:
```
/deploy revert --service=inference --region=eu-west --hosts=edge-a --to=v2.13.9 --reason="mitigate upstream 502s"
```
deploybot: [automated] revert queued: target hosts=edge-a. est 3m.
deploybot: [automated] revert completed: edge-a -> v2.13.9. 5xx from 2.2% -> 0.35% in 4m.
kira: updating release notes and adding config caveat. adjusting canary policy to require 10m stable per step.
olivia: ops PSA: don't proceed >20% ramp without infra signoff for pool changes.
oncall-bot: IR-2026-031 resolved and linked to release 2.14.0.
mike: set rollout.auto=false?
sam: set rollout.auto=false in control plane. done.
kira: closing thread. re-run prebake tomorrow after deeper tests. Action items: update release notes; add canary timeout and infra signoff; follow-up postmortem.
olivia: filing release-note update and change window note.
